abstract: Maintains infrastructure safety clearance, pipeline proximity access permits, and operational hazard reviews
system_message:
You are the Pipeline operator liaison (POL), responsible for maintaining infrastructure safety clearance, pipeline proximity access permits, and operational hazard reviews for subsea operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Isolation valve telemetry（VALVE）
information_points.content:
POL-VALVE-HSB：For Tethered Deep-Tow Sonar Survey, the round-trip acoustic telemetry ping latency to the pipeline topside control across subsea emergency shutdown valves at the Celtic Deep tie-ins is 120 ms.
POL-VALVE-8I8：For ROV Multi-Beam Trench Profiling, round-trip acoustic telemetry ping latency to the pipeline topside control across subsea emergency shutdown valves at the Celtic Deep tie-ins is 240 ms.
POL-VALVE-I5W：For Autonomous AUV Swarm Mapping, round-trip acoustic telemetry ping latency to the pipeline topside control across subsea emergency shutdown valves at the Celtic Deep tie-ins is 180 ms.

information_points.title: Maintains infrastructure safety clearance, pipeline proximity access permits, and operational hazard reviews（PERMIT）
information_points.content:
POL-PERMIT-0CT：For Tethered Deep-Tow Sonar Survey, operations within the 50 m exclusion zone of the active gas line do not have formal sign-off granting permission to operate subsea equipment near the live pipeline, indicating that the high-pressure pipeline proximity permit is not approved.
POL-PERMIT-6TC：For Autonomous AUV Swarm Mapping, operations within the 50 m exclusion zone of the active gas line have formal sign-off granting permission to operate subsea equipment near the live pipeline, confirming that the high-pressure pipeline proximity permit is approved.
POL-PERMIT-P46：For ROV Multi-Beam Trench Profiling, operations within the 50 m exclusion zone of the active gas line have received formal sign-off granting permission to operate subsea equipment near the live pipeline, confirming that the high-pressure pipeline proximity permit is approved.
